title: Ghana Empire (c. 300-1200 CE)
key_facts: First major West African empire south of Sahara
Wealth from gold and salt trade across Sahara
Capital at Kumbi Saleh, major trading center
Influenced development of later Mali and Songhai empires
causes: Control of trans-Saharan gold trade routes
Military organization with cavalry and iron weapons
Strategic location between gold fields and desert
outcome: Declined due to environmental changes and competition
Absorbed by Mali Empire around 1200 CE
Legacy of gold trade and Islamic scholarship
Influenced later West African political organization
impacts: Created urban centers of learning and commerce
Influenced later African empires and kingdoms
